market_summary: USD and safe havens maintain a risk-off drift in late London trade. XAUUSD and BTCUSD exhibit clean structural trend continuation below their respective session VWAPs, EMA50 baselines, and Value Area Lows with aligned bearish cumulative delta. Meanwhile, EURUSD and US100 remain range-bound inside Value Area chop awaiting New York liquidity.

signals.rationale: Price is trading below VAL (3963.84) and below POC (3978.28), confirming value area displacement to the downside. Cumulative Delta is BEARISH (-3.27) with a slight positive slope. We are in LONDON_SESSION. Price remains strongly bearish below both VWAP (3970.67) and EMA50 (3966.70). The signal candle consolidated near the EMA20 baseline and the forming bar is breaking down towards the lower ATR band (3937.22). RVOL remains normal at 0.593 without high-volume exhaustion, keeping continuation valid toward Session Low (3924.30). GEX is null.
